Who we are

Built for American weather

We started Sunshield America to solve a problem every homeowner and building manager knows: rooms that overheat, fading furniture, and cooling bills that climb every summer.

Our crews are trained and certified installers, working on everything from a single home window to a full commercial storefront. We measure, quote, and install with the same crew from first visit to final walkthrough — no subcontracted install teams.

Every project starts with a heat and glare assessment specific to your windows' orientation, glass type, and climate zone, so the film we recommend fits your building, not the other way around.

What we install

Window tinting, done right

Four film categories, each matched to a different building and a different problem.

Residential window tinting

Cuts glare, heat, and UV through your home's existing glass, keeping the view clear and the room cooler.

Commercial window tinting

Low-emissivity film for office towers, retail storefronts, and multi-unit buildings, installed on a schedule that works around business hours.

Anti-glare & UV film

High-clarity film that blocks up to 99% of UV rays without darkening the glass, protecting furniture and flooring from fading.

Privacy & decorative film

Frosted and tinted finishes for conference rooms, ground-floor windows, and storefronts that need light without visibility.
